answer_1.quote: In this paper, we propose a reinforcement learning method for multi-party dialogue generation (MDG) ... we conduct extensive experiments on two popular Ubuntu IRC channel datasets ...

answer_2.quote: We follow previous work for automatic and human evaluation. The automatic metrics include BLEU-1 (B1), BLEU-2 (B2), BLEU-3 (B3), BLEU-4 (B4), METEOR (M), and ROUGE L (R L ).

answer_3.quote: Given that GPT-4 has been widely used for pairwise evaluations, we employ GPT-4 as a judge to determine which response is more relevant to the topic of the target utterance.

answer_4.quote: We randomly sampled 200 examples from the test set and recruited three computer science master students ... Each human evaluator assigns three binary scores for each response ... fluency, informativeness, and relevance.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate each generated response on three binary criteria: fluency, informativeness, and relevance to the target utterance.
